meta.disclaimer: DEMO / SIMULATED HACKATHON DATA. Routes, route numbers, timetables, buses, registrations, drivers, trips, delays, alerts and history are invented for a hackathon demonstration. They are NOT official Karachi public transport data and do not describe any real operator, BRT line or bus service. Stop coordinates are approximate positions of well-known public landmarks; a landmark being real does not mean a bus stop exists there. Driver names are fictional.
meta.relationship_to_seed_data: Standalone dataset prepared independently of the database (docs in docs/standalone/). It is separate from data/karachi-demo-data.json, which is generated from supabase/seed.sql by scripts/export-demo-data.mjs. IDs, routes and stops differ between the two.

units.duration: minutes unless the field name ends in _s

meta.time_convention: All times are offsets from T0, the moment the demo data is loaded / the simulator starts. *_offset_min fields are minutes (negative = before T0); *_s fields are seconds after T0. Convert with absolute = T0 + offset.

definitions.progress_km: Distance travelled along the route direction from its first stop, measured on the route distance scale (distance_from_start_km).
definitions.delay_min: (minutes since scheduled start) - (scheduled offset at the current progress, interpolated linearly between stops). Positive = late, negative = early.
definitions.position: Straight-line interpolation between consecutive stops by the progress fraction of the segment (not road-snapped).
definitions.stop_to_stop_times: scheduled_offset_min and *_run_min measure arrival-to-arrival, so they already include the dwell at the earlier stop.
